title: V4 Atomic Style Definition + Style Variant
description: FROZEN shape for a single atomic style object (a local style on an element OR a global class in the e_global_class CPT). Verified against elementor/modules/atomic-widgets/styles/style-definition.php:36-39 (id/type/label/variants) and style-variant.php:38-42 (meta:{breakpoint,state}, props). TS type names: StyleDefinition, StyleVariant, StyleMeta (WP-F03). The props map keys are Style-Schema CSS prop names; values are atomic TypedValue envelopes. The PHP Style_Parser dry_run (WP-P03) is the AUTHORITATIVE validator of prop keys/values/enums; this schema only enforces structure.

BreakpointKey.description: null = base/desktop. Active breakpoint keys are site-dependent; canonical superset from core/breakpoints/manager.php:17-23 — mobile, mobile_extra, tablet, tablet_extra, laptop, desktop, widescreen. Resolve the live set via elementor.breakpoints.get; NEVER hardcode px widths.

StyleState.description: Variant state. null = normal. Allowed non-null values verified against styles/style-states.php:6-12. State lives on variant.meta, NEVER on a prop.

StyleMeta.description: Variant selector context. breakpoint + state together determine which CSS rule the variant emits.

StyleVariant.description: One responsive/state variant of a style. props is a flat map of Style-Schema CSS prop name -> atomic TypedValue. custom_css is Pro-only (raw escape hatch); null/omitted on free, where it is stripped (atomic-widget-styles.php:94-114).

props.description: css-prop-name -> TypedValue envelope. Keys MUST be Style_Schema-valid (probe via elementor.schema.styles). PHP dry_run authoritative.

StyleDefinition.description: A style object. As a LOCAL style it lives in an element's `styles` map keyed by its id (convention e-<elementId>-<7hex>) AND its id MUST also appear in that element's `classes` prop (else the style silently detaches). As a GLOBAL CLASS it lives in the e_global_class CPT (id g-*) and is referenced by id only. type is 'class' for both.

id.description: Local style id convention: e-<elementId>-<7hex>. Global class id convention: g-<hex>. Matches the classes name regex.

label.description: Human label. For global classes: 2-50 chars, no spaces, no leading digit / -- / -digit, not reserved 'container'. Duplicate global-class labels are auto-renamed by the REST PUT (DUPLICATED_LABEL soft error).
